text.en:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Suruhanjaya Perkhidmatan (Pindaan Jadual) (No. 2) 2012.

 (2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa pada

1 Ogos 2012.

Pindaan Jadual

2. Jadual kepada Akta dipinda di bawah tajuk "ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES

APPLICABLE TO ALL COMMISSIONS"—

(a) dengan menggantikan subperenggan 1(a) dengan subperenggan yang

berikut:

"(a) on outstation duty for a period of twenty-four hours and above:

Chairman equivalent to a member of the public

service in Premier/Special Grade "A" on

such terms and conditions as stipulated in

Treasury Circular No. 2 of 1992 or as may

be determined by the Treasury from time

to time.

Deputy Chairman equivalent to a member of the public

service in Premier/Special Grade "B" on

such terms and conditions as stipulated in

Treasury Circular No. 2 of 1992 or as may

be determined by the Treasury from time

to time.

Members equivalent to a member of the public

service in Premier/Special Grade "C" on

such terms and conditions as stipulated in

Treasury Circular No. 2 of 1992 or as may

be determined by the Treasury from time

to time.";

(b) dengan menggantikan perenggan 2 dengan perenggan yang berikut:

"2. HOTEL ACCOMMODATION EXPENSES AND LODGING

(DOMESTIC):

Chairman equivalent to a member of the public

service in Premier/Special Grade "A" on

such terms and conditions as stipulated in

Treasury Circular No. 2 of 1992 or as may

be determined by the Treasury from time

to time.

Deputy Chairman equivalent to a member of the public

service in Premier/Special Grade "B" on

such terms and conditions as stipulated in

Treasury Circular No. 2 of 1992 or as may

be determined by the Treasury from time

to time.

Members equivalent to a member of the public

service in Premier/Special Grade "C" on

such terms and conditions as stipulated in

Treasury Circular No. 2 of 1992 or as may

be determined by the Treasury from time

to time.";

(c) dengan menggantikan perenggan 6 dengan perenggan yang berikut:

"6. MONTHLY HOUSING ALLOWANCE:

Chairman RM2,500

Deputy Chairman RM1,600

Members RM1,300";

(d) dengan menggantikan perenggan 10 dengan perenggan yang berikut:

"10. DRIVER'S ALLOWANCE:

Chairman and

Deputy Chairman

provided with a driver or if the driver employed is

not from the public service, the salary is based on

Grade R3 of the Malaysian Remuneration System.

Members equivalent to a member of the public service in

Premier/Special Grade "C" on such terms and

conditions as stipulated in Treasury Circular No. 2

of 1992 or as may be determined by the Treasury

from time to time.";

(e) dengan menggantikan perenggan 12 dengan perenggan yang berikut:

"12. MONTHLY ENTERTAINMENT ALLOWANCE:

Chairman RM5,000

Deputy Chairman RM3,050

Members RM2,500";

(f) dengan menggantikan perenggan 14 dengan perenggan yang berikut:

"14. HOUSE UPKEEP ALLOWANCE:

Chairman RM3,000 per year

Deputy Chairman and Members RM2,000 per year";

(g) dengan menggantikan perenggan 16 dengan perenggan yang berikut:

"16. SERVANTS' ALLOWANCE:

Chairman RM1,000 per month

Deputy Chairman and Members RM500 per month"; dan

(h) dengan menggantikan subperenggan 22(a) dan (b) dengan subperenggan

yang berikut:

"(a) Subsistence Allowance

Chairman equivalent to a member of the public

service in Premier/Special Grade "A" on

such terms and conditions as stipulated in

Treasury Circular No. 2 of 1992 and

Treasury Circular No. 6 of 2001 or as may

be determined by the Treasury from time

to time.

Deputy Chairman equivalent to a member of the public

service in Premier/Special Grade "B" on

such terms and conditions as stipulated in

Treasury Circular No. 2 of 1992 and

Treasury Circular No. 6 of 2001 or as may

be determined by the Treasury from time

to time.

Members equivalent to a member of the public

service in Premier/Special Grade "C" on

such terms and conditions as stipulated in

Treasury Circular No. 2 of 1992 and

Treasury Circular No. 6 of 2001 or as may

be determined by the Treasury from time

to time.

(b) Hotel Accommodation Expenses and Lodging

Chairman equivalent to a member of the public service

in Premier/Special Grade "A" on such terms

and conditions as stipulated in Treasury

Circular No. 2 of 1992 and Treasury Circular

No. 6 of 2001 or as may be determined by

the Treasury from time to time.

Deputy Chairman equivalent to a member of the public service

in Premier/Special Grade "B" on such terms

and conditions as stipulated in Treasury

Circular No. 2 of 1992 and Treasury Circular

No. 6 of 2001 or as may be determined by

the Treasury from time to time.

Members equivalent to a member of the public service

in Premier/Special Grade "C" on such terms

and conditions as stipulated in Treasury

Circular No. 2 of 1992 and Treasury Circular

No. 6 of 2001 or as may be determined by

the Treasury from time to time.".

Dibuat 19 Oktober 2012

DATO' SRI DR. ALI BIN HAMSA

REGULATIONS 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 13 of the Service Commissions Act 1957

[Act 393], the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following regulations:
